finding.headline: "The Receipt Shock"
finding.problem: "One tiny outfit, wipes, formula sample — ₦40,000 gone. I came to buy 'essentials' and the marketers won. What did I actually need?"
finding.person: Nigerian mum on maternity leave, Naira strained, first shopping trip balloons.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (local + diaspora budget angle) / Bundle with D3.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
